reviews.author: Emma Oakley
reviews.text: Lluna Plena Flors created all of the floral decor and bouquets for my April 2025 wedding-- everything was gorgeous beyond words and everything I could have imagined. I planned my wedding from the US and even without seeing any designs beforehand, it was perfect. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Rachel Esfahani
reviews.text: Lluna Plena Flors created my flowers for my wedding in April 2023, I planned my wedding from the UK so never was able to physically see any displays & only sent photo examples via my wedding planner. I saw all my flowers for the first time on my wedding day & wow, I was absolutely blown away. Everything was absolutely beautifully perfect, it was all I could of ever dreamed & wished for. Thank you for helping make my wedding day perfect!

reviews.author: Dana Jones
reviews.text: Lluna Plena Flors did our flowers for our intimate wedding and they were absolutely beautiful. I had planned the wedding from the U.S. and unable to see any flowers in person prior to the wedding day. I sent Lluna Plena Flors inspiration photos from pinterest. The flowers were everything that I had envisioned, probably even better!  The team was so sweet and professional through the whole process.

reviews.author: Rocío gonzalez de la higuera
reviews.text:
Carmen took care of all the floral decorations for my wedding, with impeccable taste and the utmost respect for our personalities.
Carmen's service and attention were exquisite; she is a very warm and caring person. She always guided us while respecting our tastes and personalities.
She traveled to different locations to deliver everything where it needed to be, and she was attentive to every comment we made during the months leading up to the celebration (with great patience and managing our nerves).
We are very grateful and will recommend her to anyone who might need her services because the experience was perfect!

The arch and flowers for the ceremony and reception featured orange and beige gerberas, blue hydrangeas, blue peniculata, beige pampas grass, and eucalyptus. My bouquet, very personal and unique, consisted of white orchids, orange astromedia, blue peniculata, and eucalyptus. It had a wild, wildflower style wrapped in a blue ribbon with a starfish and seashells, very fitting for my nautical wedding.

A color combination that turned out so cheerful and in perfect harmony with the surroundings.

Thank you, Lluna Plena, for your fabulous willingness and excellent taste in decorating our wedding!

reviews.author: Imma Espejo
reviews.text: Lovely place. The people who serve are very nice. I trusted them to make me two floral arrangements and I was delighted.
